If you're a fan of osu!Mania, but not a fan of DJMAX RESPECT V, and like charts that are curated and playtested, then this is the VSRG for you. As someone who plays too many, this is probably one of the best on steam.
The harder cousin of DJMAX. It is pretty good but if you aren't down for songs that sound like they came out of the mid to late 2000s you probably won't enjoy it. For me that's nostalgic. …

i bought the dlc on sale during spring the game looks nice but flashflash revulution is free and has more songs, dont get me wrong i still play this game for 4k and 6k practice but the dlc price is scummy
不得不说前辈就是前辈，可能是因为新鲜感吧玩起来停不下来，判定确实比较严，但玩久了提升比较大，也是赶上打折了，直接怒氪900毕业，好玩！！！
